text:
Type: narrow white metal and glass shelving unit
Use: displaying books, plants and decor in a slim space; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame, tempered glass shelves
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: tall slim open frame of thin square tubes, glass shelves on five levels, open back and sides, airy and see-through, light visual weight
Feel: light, airy, fresh, delicate
Goes with: white walls, light wood, green plants, ceramics; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: VITTSJ
product.description: Tempered glass and metal are durable materials that provide an open, airy feel.
